paragraphs: Rabbi Yose the Tall: Bereshit Rabbah, Vayechi, section 97: wherever Rabbi Yose the Tall appeared, Rabbi appeared with him, for he was always with Rabbi. Also Shemot Rabbah, chapter 2. Yuchasin, under aleph, Rabbi Assi, writes: Rabbi Assi the Tall; another version, Rabbi Yose. He is Isi HaBavli. I do not know whence he derived this. Gilgulei Neshamot writes that he was a spark of Mordekhai and a spark of Rabbi; see there.
